title.zh: 雷电接口是怎么工作的

desc.zh: 一根 USB-C 线，为什么能同时带显示器、网卡、硬盘和充电，还能一台接一台串下去？雷电和 USB4 到底是什么关系？八个可以拖动的模型：CC 线上的分压、带校验的 4 字节包头、一条链路怎么分给几条隧道、菊花链、PAM3 与 3+1 非对称、显示器要多少带宽、PD 怎么谈出 140 瓦、IOMMU 按页开门。
desc.en: Why can one USB-C cable carry a monitor, a network adapter, a drive and charging at once, and chain one device after another? How do Thunderbolt and USB4 relate? Eight models you can drag: the CC divider, the 4-byte header with its check, how one link is shared among tunnels, the daisy chain, PAM3 and the 3+1 split, what a monitor needs, how PD negotiates 140 W, and the IOMMU's page-sized doors.

title.zh: USB-C 的 24 根针和 CC 线
title.en: The 24 Pins of USB-C and the CC Line

desc.zh: USB-C 插座两排各 12 根针、旋转对称；线里只有一根 CC 导线，CC 针上的分压同时告诉电脑插头朝向和对面肯给多少电流（56/22/10 kΩ 对应默认/1.5 A/3 A）。
desc.en: The Type-C receptacle has two rotationally symmetric rows of 12 pins; the cable carries one CC wire, so the divider on a CC pin tells both the plug orientation and the advertised current (56/22/10 kΩ for default/1.5 A/3 A).

zh: USB-C 为什么正反都能插

title.zh: USB4 路由器与隧道：4 字节包头
title.en: USB4 Routers and Tunnels: the 4-Byte Header

desc.zh: USB4 和雷电不在线上同时跑三种协议：DP、USB 3、PCIe 各进一个适配器，被切成带 4 字节包头（PDF、HopID、Length、HEC）的包，按 HopID 逐跳转发；HEC 是能纠正单比特错误的 CRC-8。
desc.en: USB4 and Thunderbolt carry DisplayPort, USB 3 and PCIe as packets with a 4-byte header (PDF, HopID, Length, HEC), forwarded hop by hop by HopID; the HEC is a CRC-8 that corrects single-bit errors.

zh: 雷电怎么同时传视频和数据
一根线怎么同时传显示和数据
en: how Thunderbolt carries video and data

title.zh: 一条 USB4 链路怎么分带宽
title.en: How One USB4 Link Is Shared

desc.zh: 连接管理器先留 10% 余量，先给显示器预留，每条 USB3/PCIe 路径至少 1.5 Gb/s，剩下的平分，再按权重轮转调度；显示只占往下的方向，所以读盘不和显示器抢。
desc.en: The Connection Manager keeps a 10% guard band, reserves display bandwidth first, gives each USB3/PCIe path at least 1.5 Gb/s and splits the rest; displays only use the downstream direction, so reading a drive does not compete with them.

zh: 雷电扩展坞为什么硬盘慢
en: why is my drive slower with a monitor on the dock
what is inside a Thunderbolt dock

title.zh: 雷电菊花链：一台接一台

desc.zh: 每台设备里有路由器，下行口就是下一条链路；最上面那条线要带下面所有流量，串起来的盘共享同一条 PCIe 隧道；USB4 最多 5 层，兼容雷电 3 时 6 层。
desc.en: Each device holds a router whose downstream port starts the next link; the top link carries everything below it and chained drives share one PCIe tunnel; USB4 allows depth 5, 6 in Thunderbolt 3 compatibility.

zh: 雷电设备串联会变慢吗
en: how many Thunderbolt devices can be chained

title.zh: 80 Gb/s 怎么来：PAM3 与 3+1 非对称
title.en: Where 80 Gb/s Comes From: PAM3 and 3+1

desc.zh: USB4 2.0 Gen 4 用三电平，每 7 个符号装 11 位，25.6 GBd、每条线约 40 Gb/s；非对称模式把四条线改成三去一回，往下 120、往上 40。
desc.en: USB4 2.0 Gen 4 uses three levels, 11 bits in 7 symbols at 25.6 GBd, about 40 Gb/s per lane; the asymmetric mode turns the four lanes into three one way and one back, 120 down and 40 up.

title.zh: USB-C 接显示器要多少带宽
title.en: How Much a Monitor Needs over USB-C

desc.zh: 一台显示器要的带宽是像素时钟（含消隐）乘以每像素位数；DP Alt Mode 直接占用高速线，隧道里则看连接管理器按整条 DP 链路还是按需预留，后者决定第二台屏幕亮不亮。
desc.en: A display needs pixel clock (with blanking) times bits per pixel; DP Alt Mode takes the high-speed pairs directly, while in a tunnel the Connection Manager reserves either the whole DP link or what is needed, which decides whether a second screen lights up.

en: second monitor not working on dock

title.zh: USB PD：谈出来的瓦数与 EPR
title.en: USB Power Delivery: Negotiated Watts and EPR

desc.zh: 插上时只有 5 V，更高电压靠 CC 线上的 PD 消息谈定；3 A 的线最多 60 W，没有 EPR 标记最多 100 W；EPR 的 28/36/48 V 可到 240 W。
desc.en: VBUS starts at 5 V; higher voltages are negotiated by PD messages on CC; a 3 A cable caps at 60 W and a non-EPR cable at 100 W; EPR adds 28/36/48 V up to 240 W.

为什么 65W 充电器只有 60W
en: why does my 65W charger only give 60W

title.zh: 雷电 DMA 攻击与 IOMMU
title.en: Thunderbolt DMA Attacks and the IOMMU

desc.zh: PCIe 隧道让外接设备能直接读写内存；IOMMU 按 4 KiB 页放行，所以缓冲区同页的其他数据也被暴露（Thunderclap）；Thunderspy 攻击雷电 1–3 控制器；Kernel DMA Protection 在登录前拦住不支持重映射的设备。
desc.en: A PCIe tunnel lets an external device read and write memory; the IOMMU grants whole 4 KiB pages, exposing whatever shares a page with a buffer (Thunderclap); Thunderspy targets Thunderbolt 1–3 controllers; Kernel DMA Protection blocks devices without remapping until sign-in.

title.zh: 雷电 4/5 与 USB4 的必选清单
title.en: Thunderbolt 4/5 vs USB4: the Mandatory List

desc.zh: USB4 建立在英特尔贡献的雷电协议上；协议几乎相同，区别在保证：USB4 主机的 PCIe 隧道可选，雷电 4/5 把 PCIe 隧道、速率、显示、充电和 DMA 保护都定为必须并要求认证。
desc.en: USB4 is built on the Thunderbolt protocol Intel contributed; the protocols are nearly the same and the difference is in guarantees: PCIe tunnelling is optional on USB4 hosts, while Thunderbolt 4/5 make it, the speed, displays, charging and DMA protection mandatory with certification.

title.zh: 雷电与 USB4 的前沿（2026）

desc.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：USB4 2.0 与 PD 3.3 是现行规范，雷电 5 已出货；值得盯住 DP 带宽分配模式的普及和外接 PCIe 的 IOMMU 默认策略。
desc.en: As of November 2026: USB4 2.0 and PD 3.3 are current, Thunderbolt 5 ships; watch for DP bandwidth allocation mode support and default IOMMU policy for external PCIe.

title.zh: 雷电接口是怎么工作的

desc.zh: 一根 USB-C 线能带多少东西，取决于三层：插座和线缆能过什么，路由器之间谈成了什么，连接管理器怎么分。
desc.en: What one USB-C cable can carry depends on three layers: what the connector and cable pass, what the routers negotiate, and how the Connection Manager divides it.
